stem: A 70 kg adolescent needs intravenous amiodarone in an emergency; what dose should be selected?
explanation: Amiodarone 300 mg is the correct dose because the weight-based calculation is capped at a maximum of 300 mg.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because 150 mg is below the recommended capped dose.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because 250 mg is below the recommended capped dose.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because 5 mg/kg for a 70 kg adolescent calculates to 350 mg, but the maximum dose is 300 mg.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because 350 mg is the uncapped calculation and exceeds the stated maximum dose.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because 700 mg is well above both the calculated dose and the maximum dose.
